'''Majorel''' is an international [[Service (business)|service company]],<ref>{{Cite web |author=Sara Germano |date=18 September 2018 |title=Bertelsmann to Merge Unit That Moderates for Facebook With a Competitor |url=https://www.wsj.com/articles/bertelsmann-to-merge-unit-that-moderates-for-facebook-with-a-competitor-1537273357 |access-date=25 June 2019 |website=[[The Wall Street Journal]]}}</ref> specialising in [[customer experience|customer experience (CX)]] and [[business process outsourcing|business process outsourcing (BPO)]] services. It has more than 82,000 team members{{Citation needed|date=June 2023}} and operates in 45 countries on five continents. It was formed in 2019 through the merger of the [[customer relationship management]] businesses of [[Bertelsmann]] and the {{Interlanguage link|Saham Group|fr|Groupe Saham}}.<ref>{{Cite web |date=18 September 2018 |title=Neue Partnerschaft: Bertelsmann geht bei Call-Centern mit Marokkanern zusammen |url=https://www.zeit.de/news/2018-09/18/bertelsmann-geht-bei-call-centern-mit-marokkanern-zusammen-180918-99-05135 |access-date=25 June 2019 |website=[[Die Zeit|Zeit Online]] |language=de}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |author=Tobias Buck |date=18 September 2018 |title=Bertelsmann Sets up CRM Business with Saham of Morocco |url=https://www.ft.com/content/5e31ca2a-ba90-11e8-94b2-17176fbf93f5 |access-date=25 June 2019 |website=[[Financial Times]]}}</ref>

== History ==
In September 2018, Bertelsmann and Saham announced plans to [[Mergers and acquisitions|merge]] their global customer services businesses.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Bertelsmann to Expand Customer Service Alliance with Morocco's Saham|url=https://www.reuters.com/article/us-bertelsmann-m-a-saham/bertelsmann-to-expand-customer-service-alliance-with-moroccos-saham-idUSKCN1LY0SX|date=18 September 2018|publisher=Reuters|access-date=25 June 2019}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Callcenter-Sparte: Bertelsmann holt sich nordafrikanischen Partner|url=https://www.welt.de/regionales/nrw/article181572808/Callcenter-Sparte-Bertelsmann-holt-sich-nordafrikanischen-Partner.html|date=18 September 2018|website=[[Die Welt|Welt Online]]|language=de|access-date=25 June 2019}}</ref> The two companies had already worked together successfully in this area. Following approval by the relevant [[Competition law|antitrust]] authorities, the transaction was completed at the beginning of 2019.<ref name="callcenterprofi.de">{{Cite web|title=Vollzug: Bertelsmann und Saham legen globale CRM-Geschäfte zusammen|url=http://www.callcenterprofi.de/branchennews/detailseite/vollzug-bertelsmann-und-saham-legen-globale-crm-geschaefte-zusammen-20196222/|author=Alexander Jünger|date=8 January 2019|website=CallCenterProfi|language=de|access-date=25 June 2019}}</ref> The result was a company "with enormous clout",<ref>{{Cite web|title=Bertelsmann und Saham verschmelzen CRM-Geschäfte zu Majorel|url=https://www.absatzwirtschaft.de/neuer-crm-riese-mit-enormer-schlagkraft-bertelsmann-und-saham-verschmelzen-crm-geschaefte-zu-majorel-152530/|author=Vera Hermes|date=19 February 2019|website=Absatzwirtschaft|language=de|access-date=25 June 2019}}</ref> becoming the market leader in [[Europe, the Middle East and Africa]], and a strong presence in America and Asia.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Bertelsmann bringt Callcenter-Sparte Majorel an den Start|url=https://www.focus.de/finanzen/boerse/wirtschaftsticker/unternehmen-bertelsmann-bringt-callcenter-sparte-majorel-an-den-start_id_10343196.html|date=19 February 2019|website=[[Focus (German magazine)|Focus Online]]|language=de|access-date=25 June 2019}}{{Dead link|date=August 2025 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref> The Majorel brand was introduced in February 2019.<ref>{{Cite web|title=New Global Customer Experience Company Revealed Today as Majorel|url=http://customerthink.com/new-global-customer-experience-company-revealed-today-as-majorel/|date=19 February 2019|website=CustomerThink|access-date=25 June 2019}}</ref><ref name="handelsblatt.com">{{Cite web|title=Dialogmarketing: Bertelsmann und Saham geben ihrer Dienstleistungsgruppe einen Namen|url=https://www.handelsblatt.com/unternehmen/it-medien/dialogmarketing-bertelsmann-und-saham-geben-ihrer-dienstleistungsgruppe-einen-namen/24010590.html|author=Catrin Bialek|date=19 February 2019|website=[[Handelsblatt]]|language=de|access-date=25 June 2019}}</ref> Since then, the company focused on global expansion.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Bertelsmann's Relaunched Call-Centre Business Plans Global Expansion|url=https://www.reuters.com/article/bertelsmann-majorel/bertelsmanns-relaunched-call-centre-business-plans-global-expansion-idUSL5N20E5JE|date=19 February 2019|publisher=[[Reuters]]|access-date=25 June 2019}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Bertelsmanns Call-Center-Geschäft investiert in globales Wachstum|url=https://www.boerse-online.de/nachrichten/aktien/bertelsmanns-call-center-geschaeft-investiert-in-globales-wachstum-1027962789|date=19 February 2019|website=Börse Online|language=de|access-date=25 June 2019}}</ref> 

Majorel has been acquired by [[Teleperformance|Teleperformance SE]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Teleperformance SE: Final Results of the Offer for Majorel|url=https://www.bloomberg.com/press-releases/2023-11-03/teleperformance-se-final-results-of-the-offer-for-majorel|date=3 November 2023|website=Bloomberg|language=en|access-date=8 November 2023}}</ref> The combined business strengthens service delivery in the Americas and Europe while increasing presence in Asia-Pacific and Africa.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Teleperformance Announces Proposed Acquisition of Majorel
|url=https://www.bloomberg.com/press-releases/2023-04-26/teleperformance-announces-proposed-acquisition-of-majorel|date=26 April 2023|website=Bloomberg|language=en|access-date=8 November 2023}}</ref> 

== Structure ==
The headquarters of Majorel are located in [[Luxembourg City]].<ref>{{Cite news|date=20 February 2019|title=Majorel mit Sitz in Luxemburg: Bertelsmann bringt Callcenter-Sparte an den Start|language=de|newspaper=Luxemburger Wort|url=https://www.pressreader.com/luxembourg/luxemburger-wort/20190220/281556587101740|access-date=26 May 2020}}</ref> The company operates as a [[Société Anonyme]] (SA).<ref>{{Cite web|title=Luxembourg Business Registers|url=https://www.lbr.lu/|access-date=25 June 2019}}</ref> On 24 September 2021, the company’s shares were listed on Euronext Amsterdam (Ticker Symbol: MAJ).<ref>{{Cite web|title=Euronext Amsterdam: MAJOREL GROUP LUXEMBOURG S.A.|url=https://live.euronext.com/de/product/equities/LU2382956378-XAMS}}</ref> Thomas Mackenbrock ([[Chief Executive Officer]]) leads the management team.<ref name="handelsblatt.com" />

== Services ==
Majorel is a [[business-to-business]] provider whose services span the entire [[Customer lifecycle management|customer lifecycle]], including [[Front office|front]] and [[back office]] processes.<ref>{{Cite web|title=NEAT Reports|url=https://research.nelson-hall.com/sourcing-expertise/neat-reports/|publisher=NelxonHall|access-date=26 May 2020}}</ref>
